messages:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout: service=answers, from=redwood/answers-v0.9.8 to=redwood/answers-v1.0.0, target=8% (eu-west), rollout_id=rl-5129, change_window=2026-04-10T20:00Z..21:00Z
release-manager: release notes posted https://go/redwood/releases/answers-1.0.0. Major: tokenization fixes + caching behavior change. QA report attached.
maya: ping SRE — any special telemetry we should watch besides 5xx and p99?
sre-oncall: watchlist: p99, 5xx, kvcache.evictions, tokenizer.timeouts. Alerts: 5xx > 0.4% sustained 6m -> pause; kvcache.evictions > 30 in 5m -> auto-rollback.
devon: is this the trimmed-kv build or default? need to know memory profile for routers.
ops: trimmed-kv enabled for canary. We'll pin canary to eu-west-3a.
deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 8% in eu-west-3a. phase=running.
qa: running quick smoke now. Posting a couple of failing examples if seen.
maya: noticing slight uptick in tail latency on router-eu-3: p99 +40% vs baseline. Not at threshold yet.
sre-oncall: tracing shows tokenizer RPC retries on a small fraction (host=tokenizer-eu-6). Sample:
```
[2026-04-10T20:03:11Z] req=5a1b tokenizer_rpc_ms=1300 retry=1 host=tokenizer-eu-6
[2026-04-10T20:03:45Z] req=5a9c resp_status=502 downstream=tokenizer
```
devon: can we temporarily reduce canary concurrency and add a runtime flag to relax token normalization?
deploy-bot: applying override: concurrency=6 for rl-5129 and adding runtime flag rl-5129.tokenizer.mode=permissive.
ops: infra pin applied to eu-west-3a nodepool.
qa: after overrides, p99 trending down to +18% and 502s reduced. Quick eval shows no quality regression on sampled set.
release-manager: proposal: HOLD at 8% for 20m. If stable, ramp to 25%. If kvcache.evictions > 30 or 5xx > 0.4% -> auto-rollback to v0.9.8. Any objections?
maya: no objections. Prefer hold and triage.
sre-oncall: monitoring; added playbook link in alert. Will escalate if thresholds hit.
devon: I'll run tokenizer profiling in dev and prep a follow-up patch.
deploy-bot: phase=paused (manual_hold) rollout_id=rl-5129 current_pct=8 note=concurrency-limited+tokenizer-flag
release-manager: thanks all — next check at 20:20Z or earlier if signal. If anyone needs immediate rollback, reply exactly "rollback" in thread.
